description: This file declares the AnonymousTokensRsaBssaClient class, which handles RSA blind signatures for anonymous tokens, including creating requests, processing responses, and verifying tokens. It is part of a cryptographic protocol implementation related to anonymous token generation and validation.

classes.name: AnonymousTokensRsaBssaClient
classes.description: Handles RSA blind signature operations for anonymous tokens, including creating signing requests, processing responses, and verifying tokens. Not thread-safe, non-copyable.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the client with a given public key.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a blind signature request from input messages and metadata.

methods.name: ProcessResponse
methods.description: Processes server response to obtain unblinded tokens.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies the validity of a given anonymous token against the public key and input message.
